title: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Apply for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) has released an official notification for the recruitment of Various Junior Research Fellow Jobs. Candidates with B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech in Electrical Engineering and Mechanical Engineering can apply for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 . Interested and eligible candidates can send their resume to the email address mentioned below. Here we have included more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details,...
